spanish: Y dijo Jehová a Moisés: Desciende, amonesta en el pueblo, no sea que irrumpan a Jehová a ver, y caiga de él mucho.

findings.issue: Qal H2040 is tear down, break down, or destroy; «irrumpan» narrows it to bursting in.
The suffix is 1st common plural (from us); «de él» is 3rd masculine singular.

notes: Imperatives, names, פן, אל, and the infinitive of seeing match the packet.
